FINDING (for the paper's methods section, not a defect of this script):
  Only the artifacts listed as verified/failed record a candidate source
  hash at all. The freeze-and-hash discipline covers a minority of the
  program. Notably M9A (topology_suite) and M9A.6 (missing_evidence_suite)
  record none -- and M9A.6 is the motivating finding of P1. Any claim that
  'implementations and protocols are frozen and hashed' must be scoped to
  the suites that actually do it.

  Second gap: the file *list* behind each hash lives in the suite module,
  not in the artifact, so verification requires reading the code that
  produced it. Future suites should record the list alongside the digest.
